challengeFindings.title: Two runs that take a lock at once on a fresh cache race to create `<name>.queue/`, and the loser exits 73 with "cannot create …: File exists"
A waiter started under `nohup` (or as a background job, which ignores SIGINT) now dies on SIGHUP / SIGINT while it waits, so its run exits 73 instead of waiting its turn
A Codex user whose `.codex` folder is a symlink gets `bkit tests jump` as an advisory, so a Codex agent jumps the line with no human approval
A waiter with `BKIT_TEST_SLOTS=2` sits idle behind a first-in-line waiter that only uses slot 1, while slot 2 is free, and can give up at its limit
A FIFO named like a ticket, held place or jump marker in a lock's queue folder hangs every waiter, every `try` and `bkit tests jump` forever, past `LOCAL_STACK_LOCK_WAIT_S` and past caller death
The skill install step blanked the integrity hash of the permanent `find-skills` skill, so a later change to that agent-instruction content can no longer be told apart from what was reviewed

challengeFindings.title: A Codex agent chains another ask-tier command before `bkit tests jump` (`gh pr close 999999; bkit tests jump build-1`), so the hook sees only the first ask match, turns it into an advisory, and the jump runs with no human approval

The human approves `bkit tests jump build-1` for a run that gave up more than 120 s ago, and the verb exits 0 saying the run moves to the front, although its held place has expired and nothing is waiting

A regular file sits at `tests.queue` (the same blocked path that makes `run` exit 73), and `bkit tests jump build-1` crashes with "Unhandled error: ENOTDIR: not a directory, scandir …" instead of refusing with "no run named build-1 waits for tests"
A FIFO named like a ticket, held place or jump marker in a lock's queue folder hangs every waiter, every `try` and `bkit tests jump` forever, past `LOCAL_STACK_LOCK_WAIT_S` and past caller death
The skill install step blanked the integrity hash of the permanent `find-skills` skill, so a later change to that agent-instruction content can no longer be told apart from what was reviewed
